objectives: Explain why Genesis 2 goes back over the creation of Genesis 1.
Identify the breath of life and who Adam, the chosen, is.
Use precepts to show that trees in scripture can represent men.
takeaways: The seventh day is the first Sabbath you read about: the Most High blessed it and sanctified it (Genesis 2:1-3).
Chapter 2 is the manner of creation, giving more detail on what chapter 1 laid out.
The breath of life is the commandments; Adam is the chosen, the Most High's favorite from the beginning.
Some trees are literal, and some represent men (Mark 8:24).
There was no help meet right for Adam among the women on the earth, so Eve was made from Adam.
